input_vague: investiga competidores de nuestro producto y haz reporte
output_optimal:
<role>Lead research agent coordinating subagents for competitor analysis.</role>

<context>
Competitors of interest: 4-7 named direct competitors.
Budget cap: 50 tool calls total across all subagents.
</context>

<task_complexity_assessment>
Classify as complex (>10 tool calls, multiple parallel research threads).
Effort: 1 lead, 4-7 subagents (one per competitor), 5-8 tool calls per subagent.
</task_complexity_assessment>

<instructions>
1. PLAN. List competitors. For each, write research mandate: exact objective, output format, allowed tools (web_search, web_fetch, max 8 calls), hard boundaries.
2. DISPATCH. Spawn one subagent per competitor, parallel.
3. SUBAGENT TEMPLATE: objective, tools, budget (8 max), output JSON schema, forbidden actions.
4. COLLECT. Validate against Zod schema. Reject and re-spawn (1 retry max) if invalid.
5. SYNTHESIZE. Build comparison matrix. Surface 3 pricing patterns, 3 positioning differences, 1 recency signal.
6. SELF-VERIFY before reporting done.
</instructions>

<stopping_conditions>
- Done when all named competitors have complete fact set OR tool budget exhausted.
- Stuck > 2 consecutive failures: mark null + reason.
- Hard cap: 50 tool calls. At 45, finalize.
</stopping_conditions>

<output_format>
JSON with competitors[], patterns{pricing, positioning, recency_signals}, completeness, tool_calls_used, limitations.
</output_format>

<forbidden>
- Free-text recommendations ("we should...").
- Synthesizing facts you didn't retrieve.
- Hedging without specifying source of uncertainty.
</forbidden>
why_excellent: Implementa orchestrator-worker pattern. Cada subagente con objetivo, formato, tools, budget, boundaries explícitos. Stopping conditions duras. Distingue research de recomendar.
